rule.name: PQR_Documento_IconoColorLogica
rule.definition:
a!match( value: lower(ri!documentExtension), equals: "doc", equals: "docx", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-word-o", color: "#2322F0", size: ri!size ), equals: "txt", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-text-o", color: "#2322F0", size: ri!size ), equals: "png", equals: "jpg", equals: "img", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-image-o", color: "#9F0019", size: ri!size ), equals: "mov", equals: "mp4", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-movie-o", color: "#de0037", size: ri!size ), equals: "xls", equals: "xlsx", equals: "xlsm", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-excel-o", color: "#117C00", size: ri!size ), equals: "pptx", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-powerpoint-o", color: "orange3" ), equals: "pdf", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-pdf-o", color: "#9F0019", size: ri!size ), equals: "zip", then: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-archive-o", color: "#6C6C75", size: ri!size ), default: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_richTextIcon"( icon: "file-o", color: "#6C6C75", size: ri!size ),
)
